data.title: Leon Lin's design workflow (Cook): the implicit loop
data.text: Leon Lin's design workflow (Cook): the implicit loop

data.title: 1 · References
data.body: 9-12 images, short prompt. Dribbble, Inspo MCP, Awwwards MCP, or a similar real app studied with a browser (full-page shots + motion recordings).
data.text:
**1 · References**
9-12 images, short prompt. Dribbble, Inspo MCP, Awwwards MCP, or a similar real app studied with a browser (full-page shots + motion recordings).

data.title: 2 · Intake
data.body: Ask every question once with defaults: references, quality bar, time limit, usage limit. Then never ask again.
data.text:
**2 · Intake**
Ask every question once with defaults: references, quality bar, time limit, usage limit. Then never ask again.

data.title: 3 · Target
data.body: 3 quick mockups on one page. Pick one, check mobile. Cheap to change before the real build.
data.text:
**3 · Target**
3 quick mockups on one page. Pick one, check mobile. Cheap to change before the real build.

data.title: 4 · Bar
data.body: A number per dimension (aim 99.9%, or ≥ 9.2/10). You correct its self-score: says 90, you say 65.
data.text:
**4 · Bar**
A number per dimension (aim 99.9%, or ≥ 9.2/10). You correct its self-score: says 90, you say 65.

data.title: 5 · Rules
data.body: Slop ban list + detector (beige, random fancy fonts, generic cards). Detect many tells at once, not one.
data.text:
**5 · Rules**
Slop ban list + detector (beige, random fancy fonts, generic cards). Detect many tells at once, not one.

data.title: 6 · Build static
data.body: Layout, type, color, spacing. No animation yet.
data.text:
**6 · Build static**
Layout, type, color, spacing. No animation yet.

data.title: 7 · Judge
data.body: Fresh-context critics, ideally another model (Sol judges Opus). Side-by-side: reference left, render right.
data.text:
**7 · Judge**
Fresh-context critics, ideally another model (Sol judges Opus). Side-by-side: reference left, render right.

data.title: 8 · Fix weakest
data.body: Specific feedback: exact color/spacing, or a marked-up screenshot. Can't name it? Ask the agent to describe what it built.
data.text:
**8 · Fix weakest**
Specific feedback: exact color/spacing, or a marked-up screenshot. Can't name it? Ask the agent to describe what it built.

data.title: 9 · Motion
data.body: Reference videos studied frame by frame; borrow ideas, never copy one part. Same judge loop.
data.text:
**9 · Motion**
Reference videos studied frame by frame; borrow ideas, never copy one part. Same judge loop.

data.title: 10 · Gate
data.body: Stills to you each round. No final render without your OK.
data.text:
**10 · Gate**
Stills to you each round. No final render without your OK.

data.title: 11 · Ship
data.body: Best scene first, honest numbers, credits.
data.text:
**11 · Ship**
Best scene first, honest numbers, credits.

data.title: State lives in cook/
data.body: brief.md · references/ · rounds/ screenshots + side-by-sides · harness/ (screenshot + grading scripts, judge prompts) · ROUNDS.md scores. Resumable after a context reset.
data.text:
**State lives in cook/**
brief.md · references/ · rounds/ screenshots + side-by-sides · harness/ (screenshot + grading scripts, judge prompts) · ROUNDS.md scores. Resumable after a context reset.

data.title: Time + pacing
data.body: Floor ~8h for demos (done in 2h = something's wrong), hard cap for small jobs, spread work across your usage limit.
data.text:
**Time + pacing**
Floor ~8h for demos (done in 2h = something's wrong), hard cap for small jobs, spread work across your usage limit.

data.title: Where we stand
data.body: Already match: separate critics, handoff/rounds file, references as files. Gaps: number bar + your score correction, side-by-side script, per-round stills gate, motion after static.
data.text: Where we already match: separate critics, handoff/rounds file, references as files. Gaps: number bar + your score correction, side-by-side script, per-round stills gate, motion-after-static.

data.title: Relay tie-in
data.body: Annotation + Design Mode put steps 8 and 10 inside Relay: you mark up the page, I fix it.
